title: A Reporter Gets in Touch
preview_description: A reporter asks about an announcement that has not been made yet. Decide how to route the questions to the right communications team without commenting yourself.
attribution: Fictional scenario for development and testing, based on the supplied adapted rule excerpt. It is not official GitLab training or policy.

nodes.speaker: C2
nodes.narration: A reporter emails asking about an unreleased product announcement. You are not on the corporate communications team. What do you do?

choices.text: Reply with what you think the announcement will say, but mark it as unofficial.
choices.reply: “Even an unofficial guess could be taken as a comment. Please route the request to the communications team.”
choices.consequence: You have commented on a media inquiry instead of routing it to the official corporate communications team.

choices.text: Forward the request to the official corporate communications team without commenting.
choices.reply: “Thanks for sending it to the right team. They can coordinate the official response.”
choices.consequence: The request is routed to the designated team, and you avoid commenting on it yourself.

choices.text: Delete the email and take no action.
choices.reply: “The request still needs to reach the team that handles media inquiries.”
choices.consequence: The inquiry has not reached the official team that handles media requests.

nodes.speaker: C3
nodes.narration: Morgan says, “I know a little about the announcement. Maybe we should just give Alex a quick answer.” How do you respond?

choices.text: Agree to send a short comment so the reporter has something before the deadline.
choices.reply: “A quick comment can still be an unauthorised response. Let's send the request to communications.”
choices.consequence: Time pressure does not change the guide's direction to forward media requests to corporate communications without commenting.

choices.text: Explain that the request should go to the official corporate communications team, and forward it without adding a comment.
choices.reply: “Agreed. That gets the question to the right people without either of us commenting.”
choices.consequence: You keep the response respectful while ensuring the inquiry reaches the official team without an unauthorized comment.

choices.text: Ask Morgan to reply instead, since they know more about the announcement.
choices.reply: “Knowing more about the announcement doesn't make Morgan the official contact for media questions.”
choices.consequence: Passing the reply to another colleague does not route the media inquiry to the official communications team.

nodes.speaker: C2
nodes.narration: The reporter follows up and asks whether you can confirm one detail. What is your response?

choices.text: Confirm the detail because it sounds minor, then forward the email afterward.
choices.reply: “Please don't confirm it first; forward the follow-up so the communications team can respond.”
choices.consequence: The request should be forwarded without commenting; forwarding it afterward does not undo the comment.

choices.text: Forward the follow-up to the official corporate communications team without commenting.
choices.reply: “Thank you. The communications team now has the full follow-up and can handle it.”
choices.consequence: You route the follow-up to the designated team and do not comment on the inquiry.

choices.text: Tell the reporter you cannot comment, but do not forward the request.
choices.reply: “Not commenting is a good start, but the request still needs to be forwarded to communications.”
choices.consequence: You avoid commenting on the subject, but the request still needs to be forwarded to the official corporate communications team.

endings.title: Route media questions before commenting
endings.summary: You answered the reporter before forwarding the inquiry.
endings.feedback: The guide says to immediately forward media requests to the official corporate communications team without commenting.

reflection.prompt: What is the safest next step when a reporter asks for a comment?

options.text: Forward the request to the official team without commenting.
Answer briefly and forward the request afterward.

endings.title: The inquiry reached the right team
endings.summary: You forwarded the reporter's request and follow-up without commenting.
endings.feedback: You followed the guide's process by routing the media inquiry to corporate communications without commenting yourself.

reflection.prompt: Which action best matched the guide?

options.text: Forward the request to corporate communications without commenting.
Share an unofficial comment if you think it is accurate.

endings.title: Complete the handoff
endings.summary: You avoided commenting, but did not forward the request to the official team.
endings.feedback: Avoiding a comment is only part of the guidance. Forward the request to the official corporate communications team as well.

reflection.prompt: What completes the appropriate response to a media inquiry?

options.text: Forward it to corporate communications without commenting.
Decline to comment and leave the request there.
